verse.verse_1: The Last Day came near, and the moon split apart.
verse.verse_2: And when they see a sign, they turn away and say, “Just a customary magic!”
verse.verse_3: And they denied and followed their own desires, whereas each matter has been decided!
verse.verse_4: And indeed the news which had a lot of deterrence, came to them.
verse.verse_5: The pinnacle of wisdom – so how will the Heralds of warning provide any benefit?
verse.verse_6: Therefore turn away from them; on the day when the announcer will call towards a severe unknown matter –
verse.verse_7: They will come out from the graves with eyes lowered, as if they were spread locusts.
verse.verse_8: Rushing towards the caller; the disbelievers will say, “This is a tough day.”
verse.verse_9: Before these, the people of Nooh denied and they belied Our bondman and said, “He is a madman” and rebuffed him.
verse.verse_10: He therefore prayed to his Lord, “I am overpowered, therefore avenge me.”
verse.verse_11: We therefore opened the gates of heaven, with water flowing furiously.
verse.verse_12: And caused springs to gush out from the earth, so that the two waters met totalling a quantity that had been destined.
verse.verse_13: And We carried Nooh upon a ship of wooden planks and nails.
verse.verse_14: Sailing in front of Our sight; as a reward for the sake of one who was rejected.
verse.verse_15: And We left it as a sign – so is there one who would ponder?
verse.verse_16: So how did My punishment turn out, and My threats?
verse.verse_17: And We have indeed made the Qur’an easy to memorise, so is there one who would remember?
verse.verse_18: The tribe of A’ad denied – so how did My punishment turn out, and My warnings?
verse.verse_19: We indeed sent towards them a severe windstorm, on a day the ill luck of which lasted upon them forever.
verse.verse_20: Smashing down men as if they were uprooted trunks of date palms.
verse.verse_21: So how did My punishment turn out, and My warnings?
verse.verse_22: And We have indeed made the Qur’an easy to memorise, so is there one who would remember?
verse.verse_23: The tribe of Thamud denied the Noble Messengers.
verse.verse_24: So they said, “What! Shall we follow a man from among us? If we do, we are indeed astray, and insane!”
verse.verse_25: “What! Of all the men among us, the remembrance has come down upon him? In fact, he is a mischievous, great liar.”
verse.verse_26: It was said to Saleh, “They will soon realise tomorrow who is the mischievous great liar.”
verse.verse_27: “We shall send a she-camel to test them, therefore O Saleh, wait and have patience.”
verse.verse_28: “And inform them that the water is to be shared between them; only those may come whose turn it is.”
verse.verse_29: In response they called their companion – he therefore caught and hamstrung the she-camel.
verse.verse_30: So how did My punishment turn out, and My warnings?
verse.verse_31: Indeed We sent upon them a single Scream – thereupon they became like the barrier builder’s residual dry trampled hay.
verse.verse_32: And We have indeed made the Qur’an easy to memorise, so is there one who would remember?
verse.verse_33: The people of Lut denied the Noble Messengers.
verse.verse_34: Indeed We sent a shower of stones upon them, except the family of Lut; We rescued them before dawn.
verse.verse_35: As a reward from Us; this is how We reward one who gives thanks.
verse.verse_36: And indeed he had warned them of Our seizure – in response they doubted the warnings.
verse.verse_37: And they tried to persuade him regarding his guests – We therefore blinded their eyes, “So taste My punishment, and My warnings.”
verse.verse_38: And indeed, the everlasting punishment overcame them early in the morning.
verse.verse_39: “So taste My punishment, and My warnings!”
verse.verse_40: And We have indeed made the Qur’an easy to memorise, so is there one who would remember?
verse.verse_41: And indeed the Noble Messengers came to the people of Firaun.
verse.verse_42: They denied all Our signs, We therefore seized them – the seizure of the Most Honourable, the All Powerful.
verse.verse_43: Are your disbelievers better than they were, or have you been given exemption in the Books?
verse.verse_44: Or they say, “We shall all take revenge as a group.”
verse.verse_45: The group will soon be routed, and will turn their backs to flee.
verse.verse_46: In fact their promise is upon the Last Day – and the Last Day is very severe and very bitter!
verse.verse_47: Indeed the criminals are astray and insane.
verse.verse_48: On the day when they are dragged upon their faces in the fire – “Taste the heat of hell.”
verse.verse_49: We have indeed created all things by a proper measure.
verse.verse_50: And Our command is only a fleeting one – like the batting of an eyelid.
verse.verse_51: And We have indeed destroyed your kind, so is there one who would ponder?
verse.verse_52: And all what they did is in the Books.
verse.verse_53: And every small and great thing is recorded.
verse.verse_54: Indeed the pious are amidst Gardens and springs.
verse.verse_55: Seated in an assembly of the Truth, in the presence of Allah, the Omnipotent King.
